title: NAP-Wave: A Neural Adaptive Plane-Wave Architecture for High-Frequency Helmholtz Problems
abstract: arXiv:2611.19603v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training neural networks to simulate highly oscillatory wavefields presents optimization challenges, often hindered by spectral bias and poorly conditioned physics-based loss landscapes. To address these challenges and enhance convergence, we propose NAP-Wave, a joint neural architecture and training strategy that expands the target scattered wavefield in an adaptive neural plane-wave basis. The basis functions are extracted from all hidden layers and modulated by trainable plane-wave carriers, embedding the high-frequency oscillatory physics directly into the network's trial space. NAP-Wave is trained on a physics-informed loss built from the Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation, so no differentiation of the network with respect to its input is required. translated_title: NAP-Wave：一种用于高频Helmholtz问题的神经自适应平面波架构
translated_abstract: 训练神经网络来模拟高度振荡的波场面临优化方面的挑战，通常受到频谱偏差以及病态的基于物理的损失景观的阻碍。为了解决这些挑战并提升收敛性，我们提出了NAP-Wave，这是一种将神经架构与训练策略相结合的方法，将目标散射波场在自适应神经平面波基中展开。基函数从所有隐藏层中提取，并由可训练的平面波载波进行调制，从而将高频振荡物理特性直接嵌入到网络的试验空间中。NAP-Wave基于由Lippmann-Schwinger积分方程构建的物理信息损失进行训练，因此无需对网络相对于其输入进行求导。我们开发了一种解耦优化策略，其中Adam更新神经平面波基的参数，而线性组合系数则通过线性求解器精确计算。
tldr: 提出NAP-Wave架构，通过可训练平面波载波调制的自适应神经平面波基展开散射波场，结合基于Lippmann-Schwinger积分方程的物理信息损失与解耦优化策略，有效克服了高频Helmholtz问题模拟中的频谱偏差和病态优化挑战。
en_tdlr: NAP-Wave introduces an adaptive neural plane-wave basis modulated by trainable plane-wave carriers, combined with a physics-informed loss derived from the Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation and a decoupled optimization strategy, to overcome spectral bias and ill-conditioned optimization challenges in simulating high-frequency Helmholtz problems.
